import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static class FastScanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        FastScanner() {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        int nextInt() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String line;
                try {
                    line = reader.readLine();
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
                if (line == null) {
                    throw new NoSuchElementException();
                }
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(line);
            }
            return Integer.parseInt(tokenizer.nextToken());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        int n = fs.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = fs.nextInt();
        int[] btcCosts = new int[100];
        int even = 0;
        int odd = 0;
        int right = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int left;
            if (right == 0) {
                left = fs.nextInt();
            } else {
                left = right;
                right = 0;
            }

            if ((left & 1) == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }

            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                right = fs.nextInt();
                int btcCost = Math.abs(left - right);
                btcCosts[btcCost] += 1;
                even = 0;
                odd = 0;
            }
        }

        int sawedAmount = 0;
        int currentBTCCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < btcCosts[i]; j++) {
                currentBTCCost += i;
                if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                    sawedAmount++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sawedAmount);
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Processor {
        private final Scanner sc;
        private final int[] btcCosts;
        private int even;
        private int odd;
        private int right;

        Processor(Scanner sc) {
            this.sc = sc;
            this.btcCosts = new int[100];
        }

        private int nextLeft() {
            if (right == 0) {
                return sc.nextInt();
            }
            int result = right;
            right = 0;
            return result;
        }

        void process(int n) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int left = nextLeft();

                if ((left & 1) == 0) {
                    even++;
                } else {
                    odd++;
                }

                if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                    right = sc.nextInt();
                    int btcCost = Math.abs(left - right);
                    btcCosts[btcCost] += 1;
                    even = 0;
                    odd = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int calculate(int btcAmount) {
            int sawedAmount = 0;
            int currentBTCCost = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < btcCosts[i]; j++) {
                    currentBTCCost += i;
                    if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                        sawedAmount++;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return sawedAmount;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        Processor processor = new Processor(sc);
        processor.process(n);
        System.out.println(processor.calculate(btcAmount));
    }
}
